pair.title: Connect a Raspberry Pi
pair.text: This app is intended to be used with RPi's on Raspberry OS. Other hardware or Linux distributions might partially work too. SSH must be enabled, and you need to use credentials with enough rights.
pair.incomplete: IP or URL, username and password must be entered!

repair.title: Repair Raspberry Pi
repair.text: Update the connection details for your Raspberry Pi. You need to enter the password again.
repair.data_error: Could not load existing device data. Please try again.
